note: Rows are copied from the Ministry of External Affairs visa-free and visa-on-arrival tables, then corrected where a destination government page checked the same day said something newer. The MEA e-visa table is not included. Empty cells are left empty.

corrections.change: MEA visa-free stay of 60 days replaced with 30 days tourism, from the Thai revision effective 15 September 2026.

corrections.why: MEA's visa-on-arrival table lists Thailand with an empty remarks cell. The Royal Thai Embassy in New Delhi says that from 15 September 2026 visa on arrival is not the rule for Indian ordinary passports; the 30-day tourist exemption is. The row is left out of the finder so it is not offered as a way in.

countries.name: Belarus
countries.notes: 30 days visa-free facility is there for Indian nationals to enter Belarus with following conditions: - a valid passport or another substituting document for traveling abroad; - financial means (at least two base amounts* denominated in dollars or Belarusian rubles for each day of stay, or 50 base amounts if the period of stay is 30 days); - medical travel insurance valid across Belarus with a minimum medical coverage of €10,000; - a valid multiple visa of the EU member states or Schengen zone with a mark in passport on crossing the border of these states and ticket with confirmation of departure from the National Airport "Minsk” within 30 days from the date of entry. -Visa-free cannot be from Moscow airport since there is no passport control.

countries.name: Kyrgyzstan
countries.notes: For Indians who hold long-term multiple-entry visas from countries such as the USA, Great Britain and the Schengen Zone will be extended with visa-free facility for a period of up to 7 days in the Kyrgyz Republic with a right to re-enter after 21 days from the date of departure from the Kyrgyz Republic. The visa-free facility to the above category of Indian citizens is subject to the following conditions: 1. Only Indian nationals entering Kyrgyzstan by air through Manas International Airport would be granted visa free regime and not to those entering Kyrgyzstan through other ports or means. 2. The US/UK / Schengen Zone visa must be on the Current and valid Passport of the visitor and not on Old and cancelled Passport.

countries.name: Malaysia
countries.notes: As per the website of Malaysian High Commission in New Delhi Malaysia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs in New Delhi says the waiver runs until 31 December 2026, for up to 30 days, for business, tourism, social visits or transit — not for taking a job. They ask for a passport valid at least six months, a confirmed return ticket, a confirmed hotel booking, and the Malaysia Digital Arrival Card submitted online within three days before arrival at https://imigresen-online.imi.gov.my/mdac/main. Immigration's own country list marks India as visa-exempt until 31 December 2026.

countries.name: Thailand
countries.notes: Tourism only, for an ordinary Indian passport, from 15 September 2026. Register on the Thailand Digital Arrival Card (https://tdac.immigration.go.th), preferably 3 days before arrival. The published exemption scheme also says travellers should carry the equivalent of 20,000 baht per person or 40,000 baht per family. India's MEA page still showed 60 days for tourism and short business when we read it on 17 Nov 2026. The Thai government's later announcement is the one to follow. Visa on arrival is not the Indian-passport rule under that announcement.
